text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was invited to the annual founding 
anniversary party hosted by Biwa 
Hayahide's family liquor store.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Uwooooh...! It's thrivinggg! All of 
organizer Hayahide's hard work paid off, 
I'm zo haaappyyy~!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
*sigh* ...So loud. I figured it'd turn out 
like this, though.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Wipe your tears, it's pathetic. It's a 
celebration... Just laugh like an idiot 
like you always do.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: !! Uwooooooohhh!! Taishin is zo kiiind!!

text_block_list.name: Taishin's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Taishin... is so full of life... It's all 
thanks to having Ticket-chan and 
Hayahide-chan by her side...

text_block_list.name: Ticket's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Come now, let's have a toast among the 
"BNW Mothers"! To cheer on 
Hayahide-chan... and to those three girls' 
friendship, right?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...The number of tipsy guests is 
increasing. It is likely that some may 
start feeling unwell or sick...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... The children are running around... 
If they slip on the stone pavement and 
fall, it could result in a serious 
accident—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The staff members appear busier than 
expected as well. If someone drops a plate 
or glass and shards scatter around—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
( ...Anxieties are welling up one after 
another. My mind feels overflowing with 
worries...)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, why not rest in the tatami 
room? We have chilled water prepared for 
you.

text_block_list.name: Tipsy Guest
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah... Maybe I will. Sorry to make 
you worry about me...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hey kids, would you like to play "Dirt 
Knight" together in the Japanese-style 
room? We have plenty of snacks and juice 
prepared!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, really!? I wanna play!" "Alright 
everyone, let's head to the room~!" "Yeah! 
Let's go, let's go~"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Good. All that remains is reducing the 
burden on the staff... A viable 
countermeasure would be increasing 
manpower, but...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: That's it...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Brian, I have a favor to ask. Could you 
assist the staff by helping with clearing 
and serving—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Already did. Fixed the serving flow too. 
...I figured that's what you'd do, sis.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: !! I see... Brian... I owe you one!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the "Founding Anniversary Party" 
proceeded without incident—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Phew, that takes care of the cleanup.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Managed strictly according to the 
timetable. Addressed every issue, kept the 
party moving seamlessly. I believe I 
fulfilled my duties as organizer, but—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if all the guests truly enjoyed 
themselves.

text_block_list.name: Hayahide's Mother
text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about?! Of course 
they did, isn't that obvious!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: !! M-Mother—and everyone from the shop...!

text_block_list.name: Hayahide's Mother
text_block_list.text:
You've always noticed the little details 
ever since you were little. Even when 
Brian went to the archery range, you 
packed so many first-aid kits and supplies 
for her—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: M-Mother, please, not that story...!

text_block_list.name: Hayahide's Mother
text_block_list.text:
And thanks to that, when Brian got hurt, 
she could treat it right away!

text_block_list.name: Hayahide's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Besides, thanks to that yellow hat, the 
archery teacher remembered her face 
immediately... right, Brian?

text_block_list.name: Liquor Store Employee
text_block_list.text:
Same for us! When you helped out at the 
shop, it was an enormous help!

text_block_list.name: Liquor Store Employee
text_block_list.text:
Customers even praised us, saying, "The 
sake packaging is so meticulous!"

text_block_list.name: Liquor Store Employee
text_block_list.text:
You mapped out all those new delivery 
routes for us too— they're still a 
lifesaver today~!

text_block_list.name: Inn Landlady
text_block_list.text:
My grandchild was thrilled to pieces too, 
saying she received an "apology letter" 
from Hayahide-chan!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: (...Ah. Is that so?)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(That day— I realized that my shortcomings 
could also become my strengths.)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(That my over-worrying nature could be 
useful at times. But—)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone has always accepted and 
appreciated me just the way I am, haven't 
they?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, everyone. Through this party, I 
was able to gain a profound insight.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Now that I have learned to reframe flaws 
as individuality, I feel ready to accept 
every part of myself—

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: See ya~, big sis with the big head~!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Wha...?! Wait, you children! I cannot 
simply overlook that choice of words!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Isn't that just another part of your 
"individuality"?
